jobs.title: Research Associate for the Project "Cluster of Excellence Understanding Written Artefacts" (Doctoral Researcher, Arabic Studies)
jobs.reason: The post requires an excellent Master's in Arabic Studies or a closely related discipline and fluency in written and spoken Arabic as an essential — the candidate holds neither and has no working Arabic. Although it is a funded PhD position, both the disciplinary qualification and the language requirement are unmet essentials, and the manuscript-cultures topic is far outside the candidate's fields.

It also expects a computer-science or comparable IT degree; the digital-humanities framing does not offset the engineering essentials.

Although this is a funded PhD post (otherwise eligible in principle), the language and field requirements are unmet essentials and the subject sits well outside the candidate's interest zones.

jobs.title: Research Associate (Doctoral Researcher) — Cluster of Excellence "Understanding Written Artefacts", Early Medieval Studies

It also requires a detailed project proposal on the materiality of written artefacts in early medieval history, entirely outside the candidate's field and interests.
jobs.type: Part-time (75% TV-L E13), fixed-term doctoral position

However attractive a funded PhD is in principle, these disciplinary and language requirements are unmet essentials.

Although it is a funded PhD post (otherwise eligible in principle), the disciplinary essential is an unmet hard requirement, and the topic sits entirely outside the candidate's interest zones.
